name: ClearMakes Agents
author: clearmakes

sections.description:
ClearMakes Agents builds an assistant from your documents, your website pages and your Google Drive folders. This plugin puts that assistant on your WordPress site as a chat button in the corner.

You make the assistant, add its files and choose its colours and greeting in ClearMakes Agents. The plugin only adds it to your site: paste the assistant’s agent ID, tick the box and save.

This plugin needs a ClearMakes Agents account. The Free plan (one assistant, 30 conversations a month) is enough to start. Paid plans start at $12 a month. See https://agents.clearmakes.com/pricing.

What you get:

  • A chat button on every page of your site.
  • Answers from the files, pages and folders you gave your assistant.
  • The look, greeting and suggested questions you set in ClearMakes Agents; change them there and the site follows.
  • Nothing is loaded until you paste an agent ID and tick the box.

Honest limits: answers in the chat do not show their sources. On the Free plan the chat shows a small “Powered by ClearMakes” line.

External services

This plugin connects your site’s visitors to a service run by ClearMakes. The plugin does nothing until a site administrator pastes an agent ID and ticks the box on Settings > ClearMakes Agents.

Once it is switched on, every page of the site loads one script, https://agents.clearmakes.com/agents.js, in the visitor’s browser. The script shows the chat button and talks to https://agents.clearmakes.com.

What is sent, and when:

  • When a page loads, the visitor’s browser asks ClearMakes for the assistant’s look and greeting. This request carries the agent ID and the normal information any web request carries (the visitor’s IP address and browser type).
  • When a visitor opens the chat and sends a message, the message text is sent to ClearMakes to be answered. ClearMakes keeps the conversation so you can read it in your ClearMakes Agents account.
  • The visitor’s browser may keep the conversation in its own storage on your site for up to 24 hours, so closing and reopening the chat does not lose it.

The plugin itself stores one setting in your WordPress database (the agent ID and whether it is on) and sends nothing to ClearMakes from your server.

  • Service: ClearMakes Agents, https://agents.clearmakes.com
  • Terms of use: https://agents.clearmakes.com/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://agents.clearmakes.com/privacy

Because the chat sends visitors’ messages to ClearMakes, tell your visitors in your own privacy policy, and add a consent step if your local law needs one. You can switch the chat off at any time by unticking the box.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Sign in at https://agents.clearmakes.com and make an assistant (the Free plan is enough).
  3. In ClearMakes Agents, open your assistant, go to Go live and copy the Agent ID.
  4. In WordPress, go to Settings > ClearMakes Agents, paste the Agent ID, tick the box and save.
sections.faq:
Do I need a ClearMakes account?

Yes. The assistant, its files and its look all live in your ClearMakes Agents account. The Free plan is enough to start.

Where do I find my agent ID?

In ClearMakes Agents, open your assistant and go to Go live. The Agent ID is on that page.

Can I change how the chat looks?

Yes, in ClearMakes Agents, under Style. The change shows on your site without touching the plugin.

How do I switch it off?

Untick the box on Settings > ClearMakes Agents and save, or deactivate the plugin.

Does it work with my page builder or theme?

The chat is a button added at the end of the page, so it works with any theme that calls the standard footer.

Where do I get help?

https://agents.clearmakes.com/docs, or write to contact@clearmakes.com.
